system_description.narrative_title: Geopolitical shocks reshaping global energy markets
system_description.narrative_summary: A wave of military strikes, non-state actor attacks and unexpected diplomatic energy deals is driving volatility across oil, diesel and transport markets, feeding through to equities, currencies and travel safety advisories. Treated as an open system, this narrative links physical flows (crude/diesel, tankers, air travel) with information flows (announcements, warnings), financial flows (futures, rates, insurance premiums) and policy responses, creating reinforcing and balancing feedbacks that amplify short-term market swings and prompt regulatory and security interventions. The result is shifting supply routes, changing risk premia and political friction as states, firms and markets react to both sudden shocks and negotiated ceasefires.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary: global hydrocarbon supply chains (crude, diesel, LNG), refining and storage capacity, maritime tanker routes and charter/insurance markets, airport/airline operations and safety advisories, major state and non-state actors directly affecting supply (e.g., Russia, Ukraine, Saudi Arabia, Iran, Houthi militants), market instruments (oil futures, tanker rates, equities, currencies), and immediate policy responses (sanctions, advisories, bilateral energy deals).
adjacent_subsystems: Global financial markets & central banking (stocks, bonds, FX, investor sentiment)
Maritime shipping, ports and insurance/charter markets
Civil aviation, passenger safety and international air traffic regulation
Regional diplomacy and security architectures (Middle East politics, NATO/EU responses)
evidence_headlines: Houthi strike on Saudi airport kills 12, worst attack on kingdom in a decade
Trump announces Ukraine energy ceasefire with Russia, surprising Zelenskiy
Oil falls on hopes Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire will boost supplies
Oil Tanker Rates Surge Amid Rising Attacks, Longer Voyages
FAA tells US airlines to exercise caution in Saudi Arabia flights, citing safety risks
Energy Stocks Rise as Global Conflicts Push Up Oil Prices

variables.name: Oil spot price level
variables.description: The system-wide market price for crude oil on the spot market, expressed as a continuous index or currency/unit at the global scale.

variables.name: Oil price volatility
variables.description: The short- to medium-term variability in oil spot and near-term contract prices measured across global markets.

variables.name: Crude flow rate
variables.description: The aggregate rate of crude oil physical movement through production, shipping and delivery channels measured per unit time at the system level.

variables.name: Diesel flow rate
variables.description: The total throughput rate of middle-distillate (diesel) supply reaching markets via refining and transport networks, measured continuously.

variables.name: LNG flow rate
variables.description: The aggregate volume flow of liquefied natural gas delivered through terminals, shipping and regasification facilities per unit time across regions.

variables.name: Refinery utilization rate
variables.description: The proportion of global refining capacity currently in productive use, expressed as a continuous percentage of nameplate capacity.

variables.name: Hydrocarbon storage volume
variables.description: The total system-level onshore and nearshore stock of crude, refined products and LNG held in storage facilities, measured in volume units.

variables.name: Tanker charter rate index
variables.description: The prevailing cost level for chartering oil tankers, aggregated into an index reflecting global demand/supply for marine transport capacity.

variables.name: Marine insurance premium level
variables.description: The average risk-based insurance cost levied on maritime cargo and hull coverage for energy shipping routes, expressed as premium rates.

variables.name: Tanker voyage duration
variables.description: The average transit time for tanker voyages between major loading and unloading hubs, capturing rerouting and delays across the system.

variables.name: Aviation route availability
variables.description: The proportion of scheduled air routes and airport services available and operating safely for passenger and cargo flights across the network.

variables.name: Travel safety advisory intensity
variables.description: The aggregated frequency and severity of official travel and safety advisories affecting air and surface transport operations across jurisdictions.

variables.name: Geopolitical conflict intensity
variables.description: The overall level of armed conflict and interstate or regional military confrontation exerting pressure on energy and transport systems, measured continuously.

variables.name: Non-state attack rate
variables.description: The frequency of hostile actions by non-state actors against energy, maritime or aviation assets per unit time across the system.

variables.name: Commodity derivatives open interest
variables.description: The aggregate open interest in energy commodity derivatives (futures/options) indicating leveraged positions and market exposure at the global level.

variables.name: Currency volatility
variables.description: The degree of exchange-rate fluctuation and FX market instability for major currencies that influence energy trade and pricing.

catalysts.title: Russia–US/Ukraine diesel-supply deal implementation
catalysts.description: Negotiations, political pushback and shipments tied to Trump’s announced Russia-Ukraine diesel arrangement that could alter diesel availability and market expectations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump announces Ukraine energy ceasefire with Russia...'; 'Russia says its diesel exports may exceed volumes announced by Trump'.

catalysts.title: Renewed Houthi strikes on Saudi aviation and infrastructure
catalysts.description: Continuing Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and related strikes that are disrupting aviation and heightening regional supply risk.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Houthi strike on Saudi airport kills 12'; 'Houthis attack Riyadh airport'; 'FAA tells US airlines to exercise caution in Saudi Arabia flights'.

catalysts.title: Sustained tanker charter-rate surge and voyage rerouting
catalysts.description: Higher charter costs and longer voyages as shippers reroute to avoid conflict zones, tightening freight capacity and delaying deliveries.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Oil Tanker Rates Surge Amid Rising Attacks, Longer Voyages'; 'Americas have glut of heavy oil due to freight squeeze...'.

catalysts.title: Riyadh airport closure and cancellations (this week)
catalysts.description: Capital airport to remain shut for the week, grounding services and disrupting regional air cargo and passenger routes.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Saudi capital's airport to remain shut this week as airlines cancel services'; 'One dead in new attack on Saudi airport'.

catalysts.title: Freight squeeze driving heavy-oil regional gluts and scramble
catalysts.description: Shipping bottlenecks cause a heavy-oil glut in the Americas while Asia and Europe compete for barrels, reallocating flows and inventories.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Americas have glut of heavy oil due to freight squeeze; Asia, Europe scramble for barrels'.

catalysts.title: Middle East LNG risk from Iran-related conflict
catalysts.description: Iran-linked war pressures sustain interruptions and investor caution in Middle East LNG exports and routes into winter.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'COMMENTARY: Middle East LNG industry remains hostage of Iran war'; 'Oil Climbs as Fighting Flares in Middle East'.

catalysts.title: EU consideration of oil & gas windfall tax
catalysts.description: European consideration of a windfall-profits tax on oil and gas could shift producer behavior and market hedging by year-end.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'EU looking at oil and gas windfall profit tax, as energy prices soar'.

catalysts.title: Credibility of Russia–Ukraine 'energy ceasefire' talks
catalysts.description: Ongoing talks and market debate over an energy ceasefire could materially shift fuel flows and prices if implemented or if it unravels.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Oil falls on hopes Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire will boost supplies'; 'Oil prices rise as Trump’s ‘energy ceasefire’ frays'.
